title: HighwayVerse: A Chain-of-Inspection Benchmark for Highway Infrastructure Anomaly Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.28800v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Practical highway infrastructure inspection entails progressive diagnostic reasoning from visual perception to maintenance decisions, yet existing benchmarks remain confined to isolated tasks, leaving Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) insufficiently evaluated across sequential inspection stages. Meanwhile, current datasets focus primarily on highway pavement defects, falling short of real-world inspection across diverse infrastructure components such as highway pavements, guardrails, glare screens, and drainage systems. To address these gaps, we formulate the Highway Infrastructure Inspection Progression Chain (HIIP-Chain), spanning Anomaly Detection, Anomaly Recognition, Condition Analysis, and Maintenance Resolution, and introduce HighwayVerse. translated_title: HighwayVerse：面向公路基础设施异常理解的链式巡检基准
translated_abstract: 实际公路基础设施巡检需要从视觉感知到维护决策的渐进式诊断推理，然而现有基准仍局限于孤立任务，导致多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在序列化巡检各阶段的能力评估不足。同时，当前数据集主要聚焦于公路路面缺陷，难以满足涵盖路面、护栏、防眩板和排水系统等多种基础设施部件的真实巡检需求。为填补这些空白，我们构建了公路基础设施巡检递进链（HIIP-Chain），涵盖异常检测、异常识别、状态分析和维护决策四个环节，并提出HighwayVerse基准。HighwayVerse包含14,143条来自地面和无人机（UAV）的真实巡检记录，分别涵盖100类和17类异常，并配有84,858条经专家审核的问题（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了贯穿异常检测、异常识别、状态分析与维护决策四阶段的递进式巡检链（HIIP-Chain）基准HighwayVerse，包含14,143条地面与无人机真实巡检记录及84,858条专家审核标注，用于系统评估多模态大语言模型在公路基础设施多部件异常理解全流程中的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces HighwayVerse, a chain-of-inspection benchmark built on the HIIP-Chain spanning four progressive stages (anomaly detection, recognition, condition analysis, and maintenance resolution), comprising 14,143 real-world ground and UAV inspection records with 84,858 expert-reviewed annotations to comprehensively evaluate MLLMs' highway infrastructure anomaly understanding across diverse components.
